name: MTalk-Bench
description: MTalk-Bench is a multi-turn speech-to-speech benchmark designed to evaluate models on semantic information, paralinguistic information, and ambient sound perception across realistic dialogue scenarios. It uses a dual-method evaluation framework combining Arena-style pairwise comparisons and Rubrics-based absolute scoring, assessed by both human evaluators and LLMs.
reputation: An emerging benchmark for speech-to-speech dialogue evaluation that is still early in community adoption.
notes: Includes evaluation of semantic, paralinguistic, and ambient sound information; combines Arena-style and Rubrics protocols; highlights limitations in current S2S evaluation.
